card.name: The end of interleukin before a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and number such as -1, -2, -6 or -15. Also weakly the ending "ens" in pollens.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The last piece of interleukin, directly before a hyphen and a number naming the type.

modes.label: Pollens ending
modes.description: The ending of pollens in lists of things that trigger allergy or breathing problems.
